tools.name: solve_internal_ballistics
tools.description: Solve one internal-ballistics point: modeled velocity/energy/pressure for an exact cartridge+bullet+powder+charge specification, wrapped in the non-removable safety envelope (charge range, closed-enum warnings, assumptions). Returns the SAME envelope as POST /v1/solve. For load DEVELOPMENT prefer ge

tools.name: trajectory
tools.description: Trajectory / drop table: point-mass (3-DOF) exterior solve fed by the modeled muzzle velocity for an exact cartridge+bullet+powder+charge spec (or an explicit muzzle_velocity_fps override). Returns range rows (drop, velocity, energy, windage) plus the model assumptions. Beta keys get the table to 30

tools.name: get_cartridge_spec
tools.description: Look up ONE cartridge in the served component database (census: mode != 'hidden' AND geloescht == 0) by name, CIP name, alternate name, or id — returns the published dimensional spec (pmax_bar, case volume, bore/case dimensions, max OAL). Identity + published dimensional metadata only — NOT load dat

tools.name: list_powders
tools.description: List propellants in the served database (optionally filtered by manufacturer substring), with the GRT attributes the solver uses (Ba, Qex). Identity + published dimensional metadata only — NOT load data (rights-class discipline): no charge/velocity/pressure values are served by this tool.

tools.name: check_component_compatibility
tools.description: Check whether a cartridge+powder pair RESOLVES in the served database and whether the published-reference corpus contains a row for the pair (nearest-bullet membership — the same membership that decides a ladder's basis). Answers membership and canonical identity ONLY; it never serves the corpus row

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: solve_internal_ballistics, generate_load_ladder · Private data: generate_load_ladder, get_cartridge_spec, list_powders, check_component_compatibility · Public sink: solve_internal_ballistics, generate_load_ladder · Destructive: trajectory.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: solve_internal_ballistics, generate_load_ladder · Private data: generate_load_ladder, get_cartridge_spec, list_powders, check_component_compatibility · Public sink: solve_internal_ballistics, generate_load_ladder · Destructive: trajectory

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
